entries.title: Proverbs 4:1
segments: Hear, [my] sons, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding:

entries.title: Proverbs 4:2
segments: For I give you good doctrine; Forsake ye not my law.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:3
segments: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:4
segments: And he taught me, and said unto me: Let thy heart retain my words; Keep my commandments, and live;

entries.title: Proverbs 4:5
segments: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;

entries.title: Proverbs 4:6
segments: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:7
segments: Wisdom [is] the principal thing; [therefore] get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:8
segments: Exalt her, and she will promote thee; She will bring thee to honor, when thou dost embrace her.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:9
segments: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace; A crown of beauty will she deliver to thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:10
segments: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:11
segments: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:12
segments: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:13
segments: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: Keep her; for she is thy life.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:14
segments: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:15
segments: Avoid it, pass not by it; Turn from it, and pass on.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:16
segments: For they sleep not, except they do evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:17
segments: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:18
segments: But the path of the righteous is as the dawning light, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:19
segments: The way of the wicked is as darkness: They know not at what they stumble.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:20
segments: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:21
segments: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:22
segments: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:23
segments: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:24
segments: Put away from thee a wayward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:25
segments: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:26
segments: Make level the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:27
segments: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: Remove thy foot from evil.
